note: All listed issues occurred before their corresponding results were accepted; fixes were applied and the frozen evaluation was resumed without changing its protocol or development backgrounds.

events.failure: training prior estimator attempted to stack a Python list of tensors
events.resolution: stacked the list explicitly; resumed the already-frozen protocol

events.failure: missing mean_jacobian import after primary evaluation rows had been saved
events.resolution: added import and ran the capacity diagnostic separately on the frozen backgrounds

events.failure: initial diagnostic compared the full after-law prediction with the effect target
events.resolution: corrected the target to after-minus-before and reran; only corrected output is in mechanism_capacity.json

events.failure: attempted NumPy conversion on a tensor with gradients enabled
events.resolution: detached evaluation tensors and reran the comparator

events.failure: legacy V2 CSV omitted scoring and raw-program columns; capacity key also used an incorrect code prefix
events.resolution: made legacy scoring explicitly marginal, derived raw accuracy from predicted/true program IDs, and corrected capacity keys

events.failure: synthetic target retained an autograd graph and failed when the same fixture was fit repeatedly
events.resolution: detached the synthetic observed target; focused and full Q1 suites then passed
